top_signals.title: Stock Rebound Eases Ahead of CPI; Anthropic IPO Marketing
top_signals.summary: US equity futures waver after S&P 500 posted its best day since April. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller shows support for an interest-rate hike in December ahead of CPI. Anthropic seeks as much as $64.4 billion in its IPO after a brief clerical misstep over the filing documents. Brent crude drops below $90 a barrel for the first time since August, while US gasoline prices dip below $4 a gallon. Kallum Pickering of Peel Hunt joins "Bloomberg Brief" to look ahead to the inflation data. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Trump says Iran war to end 'fairly soon,' plays down prospects of new strikes
top_signals.summary: “Iran militarily is effectively over,” Trump said, citing the destruction of its navy and surging inflation that he said has hollowed out Tehran's economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Pete Hegseth decries impeachment push, defends Iran war handling
top_signals.summary: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth railed against the Republican congressman who introduced articles of impeachment against him.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Transparency data: Trade Specialised Committee on Goods
top_signals.summary: The Specialised Committee monitors the implementation and functioning of the Goods market access and national treatment chapter of the Trade and Cooperation Agreement.

top_signals.title: Global Macro Funds Seen as Next Positioning Risk for US Stocks
top_signals.summary: Last week’s rout in US stocks may have flushed out some concentration excess in the markets, but it didn’t eliminate it entirely.

top_signals.title: Polish Premier Orders Gun Laws Review After First Mass Shooting
top_signals.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk asked his ministers to review the gun regulations as the country comes to terms with its first mass shooting.
